name: Masked Identity
body:
You take on a second identity to combat your enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Skill Focus (disguise).

Benefit(s): You gain the dual identity class feature of a vigilante of your character level.

Special: You cannot select this feat if you have the dual identity class feature or a feature that grants you a second identity.
